userStories.title: Add the public log git read
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a read-only git log helper in @archon/git that walks HEAD and returns parsed commits with parents and a revision fingerprint, so that downstream consumers can build commit history lane graphs.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/git/src/git-log.ts and failing unit tests in packages/git/src/git-log.test.ts covering parser, truncation, unborn/empty repositories, and real git commits with merges and dev sibling branches.

Implement parseGitLogZ(stdout: string): GitLogCommit[] splitting NUL-delimited records into 5-tuples (oid, parentsRaw, authorName, authorDate, subject); parse parents separated by spaces; validate full SHA-1 (40-char) or SHA-256 (64-char) lowercase hex object names without mixing lengths; throw 'Malformed git log output' on invalid format.

Implement gitLogResultFromStdout(stdout: string): GitLogResult requesting up to 501 commits (GIT_LOG_MAX_COMMITS + 1), returning at most 500 commits, setting truncated: true only when the 501st sentinel record exists, and calculating revision as SHA-256 of stdout (or stable empty SHA-256).

Implement isEmptyHistoryError(error: unknown): boolean matching unborn/empty repo errors ('does not have any commits yet', 'unknown revision or path not in the working tree', 'ambiguous argument \'HEAD\'').

Implement log(workingPath: RepoPath | WorktreePath): Promise<GitLogResult> using execFileAsync with exact argv ['-C', workingPath, '--no-optional-locks', 'log', '--date-order', '--format=%H%x00%P%x00%an%x00%aI%x00%s', '-z', '--max-count=501', 'HEAD'].
Export log, GIT_LOG_MAX_COMMITS, GitLogCommit, and GitLogResult from packages/git/src/index.ts.
Stub log in all 31 existing @archon/git mock factories across the codebase to prevent test leakage to live git.
Verify bun test packages/git/src/git-log.test.ts and bun --filter @archon/git test pass green.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow plan Task 1 at docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-source-control-lane-graph.md:202-654. Consumes execFileAsync and RepoPath/WorktreePath types. Create packages/git/src/git-log.ts and packages/git/src/git-log.test.ts; modify packages/git/src/index.ts and the 31 test files with mock.module('@archon/git').

userStories.title: Add GET /api/workflows/runs/{runId}/git/log route
userStories.description: As an API consumer, I want an OpenAPI endpoint GET /api/workflows/runs/{runId}/git/log, so that the web client can fetch the run checkout's commit log under standard CAP-6 confinement.
acceptanceCriteria: Add failing HTTP integration tests to packages/server/src/routes/api.git-changes.test.ts covering missing run (404), CAP-6 container (200 with emptyReason: 'container'), CAP-6 no_checkout (200 with emptyReason: 'no_checkout'), post-gate git error (500), success (200), ignored query parameters like working_path, and paired Pino events.

Update packages/server/src/routes/schemas/git.schemas.ts adding gitLogCommitSchema and gitLogResponseSchema (emptyReason optional enum 'container' | 'no_checkout', commits array, revision string, truncated boolean).
Create packages/server/src/routes/git/log-route.ts defining OpenAPI route for GET /api/workflows/runs/{runId}/git/log with 200, 404, and 500 response schemas.

Create packages/server/src/routes/git/log-handler.ts using loadRunCheckout to resolve host checkout, enforce CAP-6 container/no_checkout gate, invoke @archon/git log, recheck CAP-6 post-read on ENOENT, map unexpected errors to opaque 500, and emit paired Pino events (git.log_started paired with git.log_completed or git.log_failed).
Register the log route in packages/server/src/routes/api.ts alongside existing git routes.
Verify bun test packages/server/src/routes/api.git-changes.test.ts and bun --filter @archon/server test pass green.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow plan Task 2 at docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-source-control-lane-graph.md:655-1002. Consumes loadRunCheckout, log, toWorktreePath. Modify packages/server/src/routes/schemas/git.schemas.ts, packages/server/src/routes/api.ts, and packages/server/src/routes/api.git-changes.test.ts; create packages/server/src/routes/git/log-route.ts and packages/server/src/routes/git/log-handler.ts.

userStories.title: Implement Spike 3 commit lane assignment
userStories.description: As a graph renderer, I want a pure lane-assignment function, so that branch/merge commit history is mapped into explicit lane indices and edges before virtualization.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/web/src/components/workflows/source-control/commit-lanes.test.ts with unit tests for linear history on lane 0, merge commits connecting branches, branch convergence, octopus merges, root commits with empty parents, empty commit lists, and 500-commit stability.
Implement assignCommitLanes(commits: readonly { oid: string; parents: readonly string[] }[]): LaneGraph in packages/web/src/components/workflows/source-control/commit-lanes.ts.
Process commits in git newest-first order, maintaining active reserved lanes; assign each commit to the smallest matching incoming lane, reusable null lane, or append a new lane.
Clear incoming reservations before placing parents; connect parents in git %P order, reusing existing reservations or allocating new lanes; ensure root commits leave no outgoing reservations.
Return LaneGraph containing rows: CommitLaneRow[] with { oid, lane, incomingLanes, throughLanes, parentLanes, isMerge } and laneCount (one more than max lane index seen).
Verify bun test packages/web/src/components/workflows/source-control/commit-lanes.test.ts passes green.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow plan Task 4 at docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-source-control-lane-graph.md:1149-1443 and Spike 3 Outcome at plan:138-162. Pure function with zero DOM or React dependencies. Create packages/web/src/components/workflows/source-control/commit-lanes.ts and packages/web/src/components/workflows/source-control/commit-lanes.test.ts.

acceptanceCriteria: Add unit tests in packages/web/src/components/workflows/source-control/source-control-state.test.ts testing gitLogSnapshotReducer for first ready display, revision-divergent pending freeze, matching-revision no-op, and accepted reload swap.

Define GitLogSnapshot ({ emptyReason?: 'container' | 'no_checkout'; commits: GitLogCommit[]; revision: string; truncated: boolean }), GitLogSnapshotState, GitLogSnapshotAction, and INITIAL_GIT_LOG_STATE in packages/web/src/components/workflows/source-control/source-control-state.ts.
Implement toGitLogSnapshot(response: GitLogResponse): GitLogSnapshot and gitLogSnapshotReducer(state: GitLogSnapshotState, action: GitLogSnapshotAction): GitLogSnapshotState.
Retain existing Changes snapshot reducer and types completely unchanged to guarantee isolation under the Rule of Three.
Verify bun test packages/web/src/components/workflows/source-control/source-control-state.test.ts passes green.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow plan Task 5 at docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-source-control-lane-graph.md:1444-1668. Consumes GitLogResponse from web api client. userStories.title: Render virtualized History lane graph widget
userStories.description: As an operator, I want a keyboard-accessible virtualized commit history listbox with bespoke SVG lanes, so that I can inspect the commit graph without performance degradation or accessibility barriers.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/web/src/components/workflows/source-control/format-commit-time.ts and format-commit-time.test.ts implementing formatCommitTime(iso: string, nowMs: number): string using Intl.RelativeTimeFormat for deltas < 30 days and UTC Intl.DateTimeFormat for older dates, returning 'Unknown time' on invalid input.

Create packages/web/src/components/workflows/source-control/commit-graph-row.tsx rendering a commit row with role='option', aria-label describing commit details (merge vs ordinary, short OID, subject, author, relative time), and inline SVG lanes (width laneCount * 12px, height 24px).

SVG draws vertical through-lines for throughLanes, top-to-node curves for incomingLanes, node-to-bottom curves for parentLanes using stroke-text-secondary, strokeWidth='1.5', and NO opacity; draws circle for ordinary commits and diamond polygon for merge commits filled with fill-text-primary.

Create packages/web/src/components/workflows/source-control/commit-history-graph.tsx implementing role='listbox', aria-label='Commit history', aria-activedescendant, virtualized with @tanstack/react-virtual (row estimate 24px, 280px initial fallback).
Export and implement nextCommitIndex(key: string, currentIndex: number, commitCount: number): number supporting ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home, End; Enter/Space selects commit without opening files.
Create tests in packages/web/src/components/workflows/source-control/commit-history-graph.test.tsx verifying SVG topology, a11y roles/labels, keyboard navigation, and absence of opacity styles.
Verify bun test packages/web/src/components/workflows/source-control/ passes green.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow plan Task 6 at docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-source-control-lane-graph.md:1669-2174. Consumes assignCommitLanes, GitLogCommit, and @tanstack/react-virtual. Do not import @xyflow/react. Create format-commit-time.ts, format-commit-time.test.ts, commit-graph-row.tsx, commit-history-graph.tsx, and commit-history-graph.test.tsx in packages/web/src/components/workflows/source-control/.

userStories.title: Insert History below Changes and integrate tab queries
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the Source Control tab to fetch History on mount, display History below Changes on live checkouts, handle whole-tab CAP-6, and coordinate concurrent Reload, so that commit history is visible alongside uncommitted changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Modify packages/web/src/components/workflows/source-control/source-control-panel.tsx to accept historySnapshot and historyLoadState; render h2 'Changes' above h2 'History' on live checkouts in a vertical flex column (flex-1 min-h-0 for each region).

History region renders CommitHistoryGraph, 'No commits yet' status when empty, 'Showing the newest 500 commits.' when truncated, 'Loading history' / 'Refreshing history', or 'Could not refresh history.' with in-region Reload on error.

Enforce whole-tab CAP-6: if either Changes or History reports CAP-6, the entire panel displays the quiet CAP-6 state ('container' takes precedence over 'no_checkout'), omitting the History heading and graph.
Update packages/web/src/components/workflows/source-control/source-control-panel.test.tsx verifying two-region panel, CAP-6 exclusion of History, and empty repo 'No commits yet'.

Modify packages/web/src/components/workflows/source-control/source-control-tab.tsx to add useQuery for getWorkflowRunGitLog(runId) (staleTime: Infinity, no polling); track History snapshot with gitLogSnapshotReducer; combine stale across Changes, History, and viewer; refetch both queries concurrently on Reload; track commit selection without opening files.

Update packages/web/src/component-integration/source-control-tab.test.tsx verifying mounted log query, empty history, CAP-6 whole-tab handling, concurrent reload, and commit selection without triggering file diff/content queries.
Verify NODE_ENV=development bun test packages/web/src/component-integration/source-control-tab.test.tsx passes green.
